verdict.rationale: Supabase documents and demonstrates (via live probe) an official MCP server that lets AI assistants like Cursor/Claude connect to and query a Supabase project, effectively enabling query-writing and backend interaction — but this is delivered through external AI tools connecting via MCP rather than a built-in assistant inside the Supabase dashboard itself. Community evidence also raises real security concerns (service_role bypassing RLS, injection risks) that complicate trust in this AI-driven workflow.
